'''Vazzet Dipterz''' was a [[Cyclorrian]] [[technician]]. He managed a Cyclorrian swarm that joined the [[Resistance]] as a taskmaster and was rarely ever seen off of his [[loadlifter workframe]]. Dipterz was stationed in the [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|Resistance base]] on the [[moon]] [[Ajan Kloss]] and in [[35 ABY]], he spoke with a member of the [[Ground Logistics Division]] while stood by the [[CR90 corvette]] ''[[Tantive IV]]''.

==Biography==
Vazzet Dipterz was a [[Cyclorrian]] who acted as a taskmaster in a swarm of Cyclorrians that served in the [[Resistance]] during its [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] against the [[First Order]]. Working as a [[technician]] for the Resistance, he was part of the core group [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|based]] on the [[jungle]] [[moon]] [[Ajan Kloss]].<ref name="TROS VD" />

In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{FilmDate|IX|Dipterz's appearance}}</ref> Dipterz was on his [[loadlifter workframe]] within the base when the [[Jedi]]-in-training [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] returned from a [[Jedi training|training course]] to speak with [[General]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]]. As the pair spoke, Dipterz was speaking with a member of the [[Ground Logistics Division]] next to the parked [[CR90 corvette]] ''[[Tantive IV]]''. When the Resistance forces on Ajan Kloss latter began preparations for an [[Battle of Exegol|attack]] on the [[planet]] [[Exegol]], Dipterz was on his workframe beneath the [[CR90 corvette]] ''[[Tantive IV]]'' as it prepared to take off.<ref name="TROS">{{Film|IX}}</ref>

[[File:Dipterz_Tantive_IV.png|thumb|left|250px|Vazzet Dipterz used a workframe to move around.]]

==Personality and traits==
Vazzet Dipterz lorded it over the rest of his swarm as a taskmaster, and was bothered when the Cyclorrian [[Wizzich Mozzer]] began spreading the practice of playing [[sabacc]] throughout the swarm; however, he tolerated the behavior as long as the swarm members only indulged in the distracting activity during their allotted twenty [[Standard minute|minute]] breaks. Other members of the Resistance, particularly [[human]]s, found Dipterz's managerial style overbearing, but it was acceptable within Cyclorrian culture and produced efficient results.<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Equipment==
While serving the Resistance, Dipterz was rarely ever seen off of his loadlifter workframe, which some likened to a throne despite its industrial origins. The frame was orange in color and equipped with suspension [[servomotor]]s and exposed gyro-balance systems in its [[limb]]s, plus a lifter carriage with magnetized forks that could carry [[fuel]] canisters. The Cyclorrian wore a light brown [[Clothing|outfit]] with a gray [[jacket]] and brown [[boot]]s. He kept a brown [[scarf]] wrapped around his head that was soaked in order to prevent distraction by nearby scents.<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vazzet Dipterz was created for the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']],<ref name="TROS" /> and first identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="TROS VD" /> Dipterz was portrayed by [[Tom Wilton]], who also played [[Aftab Ackbar]] in costume in the film. While the character itself was a model, Wilton was placed in the loadlifter and moved around on set, communicating with crew members through a headset. [[Warwick Davis]], who portrayed Wizzich Mozzer, stated that the frame was quite heavy for the actor, and that the loadlifter's closed interior created a lot of heat that resulted in discomfort for Wilton.<ref name="Legacy">{{Film|IX}} 4K Ultra HD Blu-ray: "[[The Skywalker Legacy]]" featurette</ref>
